visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young women with long dark hair, wearing a white crop top/denim skirt and a brown top/grey pants, stand in a modern living room. They pose with their arms raised toward a large orange leather L-shaped sofa. The room features warm wood flooring, white textured wall panels with recessed lighting, and large windows with sheer curtains. (2) The camera pans across the living room, showing variations of the room with a grey sofa and a brown sofa before returning to the vibrant orange one. A rectangular wooden coffee table sits in the center. (3) Close-up shots focus on the sofa's details. A hand strokes the smooth orange leather. Macro views reveal a silver metal tag engraved with 'SCAN-LIVING', a grey plastic panel containing buttons and a USB charging port, and precise vertical stitching along the leather seams. (4) The women demonstrate the electric reclining function; one woman uses a remote control while sitting on the sofa, causing the footrest to extend. They are seen relaxing with a beige knit blanket and holding white coffee mugs. One woman also interacts with a wooden coffee table, placing a decorative vase with dried flowers on it. (5) The video concludes with the two women dancing joyfully in front of the sofa. The screen transitions to a white overlay with dense black text outlining promotion details, while one woman is shown wrapped in a beige blanket, lying comfortably on the reclined orange sofa.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: Two young women with long, straight dark hair. One wears a white knitted tube top and a denim mini skirt. The other wears a brown knitted sleeveless top and wide-leg grey patterned pants.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A luxury modern living room with light wood floors, a large orange L-shaped leather sofa, a wooden coffee table, white geometric wall panels, and large floor-to-ceiling windows with white sheer curtains.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with bright, high-energy electronic pop music featuring a prominent 4/4 drum machine beat. A female narrator speaks with an enthusiastic, high-pitched tone, introducing home decor tips. No environmental noise is audible, suggesting a professional studio recording environment. (2) A synthetic 'whoosh' transition sound occurs as the narrator shifts to discussing color selection. The music remains consistent in the background, providing a steady, upbeat rhythmic bed that matches the fast speech rate and frequent vocal inflections. (3) A light 'pop' sound effect highlights the mention of leather materials and technical features like the USB port. The narrator's voice maintains high clarity and positive valence, with musical synthesizers providing bright tonal textures that emphasize the professional quality of the audio track. (4) As the narration moves into the promotional offer details, a subtle 'ding' sound effect underscores key information. The speech density remains high, covering the various discount steps and codes, while the BGM reaches a steady harmonic plateau before concluding with a soft fade-out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Feature Showcase (Color/Material/Function) -> Demonstration -> Promotion Details -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a commercial collaboration between influencers Sandy & Mandy and the furniture brand Scan-Living (詩肯居家). Its objective is to showcase the aesthetic and functional benefits of their electric leather sofas, specifically promoting a 'Cozy Home Upgrade' campaign with an exclusive discount code and gift incentives for viewers.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct mention of the brand '詩肯居家' (Scan-Living), demonstration of products with brand logos, and the inclusion of specific discount codes and promotional events.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video utilizes twins' synergy and high-key, warm lighting to create a welcoming domestic atmosphere that aligns with the premium yet accessible positioning of the furniture brand.
